steps.code:
# Fetch songs from each playlist
access_token = _mem['s6']['access_token']
playlist_ids = [346, 347, 348, 349, 350, 351, 352]
all_songs = {}  # song_id -> set of artist_ids
for pid in playlist_ids:
    pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=access_token)
    print(f"Playlist {pid}: {pl['title']}, songs: {len(pl['songs'])}")
    for song in pl['songs']:
        sid = song['id']
        if sid not in all_songs:
            all_songs[sid] = set(song['artist_ids'])
        else:
            all_songs[sid].update(song['artist_ids'])
print(f"Total unique songs: {len(all_songs)}")
